title: New Tires from $120 in West Palm Beach | Los Paisas Tires Shop
description: New Cosmo tires from $120 (R15–R18) at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach. Catalog price includes alignment and balancing. Open 7 days, 8 AM–7 PM. (561) 429-4041.
h1: New Tires in West Palm Beach
eyebrow: Tire shop on S Military Trl
intro: New tires in West Palm Beach start with the car in front of us, not with a slogan. Los Paisas Tires Shop is at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. We sell new tires and used tires, and we will tell you when a new tire is the right buy and when a checked used tire is enough.

New Cosmo tires start at $120 per tire, R15 to R18, including two LT sizes and one C size. The full size and price table is on this page, and the catalog price includes alignment and balancing. Prices are subject to change without notice, so call or WhatsApp (561) 429-4041, any day from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, to confirm your size is in stock before you come. Driving in from Greenacres, Palm Springs, or Lake Worth Beach? Those areas are within 10 miles of this one shop on Military Trail.

sections.heading: What buying new tires includes
paragraphs: A new set is the tire, the mount, and a straight conversation about the other three corners. Replacing one bald tire and leaving three worn ones is how a car starts to feel wrong at highway speed. We look at all four, plus the spare if you still rely on it, and we say whether you need one tire or more.

Florida heat is hard on rubber that already lived a life in the sun. A new tire does not fix a bent wheel. When you buy a new tire from the catalog on this page, the listed price already includes alignment and balancing, so the new tread starts out straight and smooth instead of scrubbing off in a month.

sections.heading: How we match a tire to the car
paragraphs: Bring the car if you can. The placard in the door jamb is the reference for size and for the cold pressure that belongs to that vehicle. We do not invent a pressure number on a web page. If you only know the size printed on the old tire, call and read it to us. If that old tire was already the wrong size, we will say so.

The visit is simple. You pull in during open hours, Monday through Sunday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. We confirm the size, show you the tire, mount it, and set you back on the road. English or Spanish, same counter. If you bought tires online and only need them mounted, use the install page. This page is for tires you buy from the shop.

sections.heading: Walk-in visit for new tires
paragraphs: No appointment is required. Pull into 1114 S Military Trl during open hours — Monday through Sunday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM — and we match the size from the door placard or from the size you read over the phone.

We accept cash, credit card, debit card, and NFC (contactless). The new-tire prices are in the table on this page, from $120 to $190 per tire, and they include alignment and balancing. Prices are subject to change without notice; call (561) 429-4041 to confirm the size and the price before you come.
bullets: Walk-ins welcome; call (561) 429-4041 if you want the size checked first
English or Spanish at the same counter

sections.heading: The shop on S Military Trl
paragraphs: The only address is 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. People drive here from Greenacres, Palm Springs, and Lake Worth Beach. All three are inside the 10-mile area around the shop. Come to the bay when the car can roll. If a tire is already flat and you should not drive, call and ask about the mobile van, which stays within those 10 miles and is not a second address.

We are a tire shop. The work on this page is new tires, mounted here. Alignment and balancing are included with the listed catalog new tires; if you only need an alignment or balancing on tires you already have, that is a separate service, quoted on its own page.

faqs.question: How much do new tires cost?
faqs.answer: New Cosmo tires start at $120 per tire (195/65 R15, 205/65 R15, and 205/55 R16) and go up to $190 for 265/70 R17 LT. The full table of 26 sizes, R15 to R18, is on this page. Prices are subject to change without notice, so call or WhatsApp (561) 429-4041 to confirm your size is in stock.

faqs.question: Does the new tire price include alignment and balancing?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you buy a new tire from Los Paisas Tires Shop, mounting and balancing are included in the price. For the Cosmo catalog tires listed on this page, the listed price also includes alignment. Alignment or balancing on its own, without buying one of these new tires, is a separate paid service.

faqs.question: Why are there two 205/65 R16 and two 265/70 R17 tires?
faqs.answer: They are different tires. 205/65 R16 comes as a standard passenger tire ($155) and as a C (commercial) tire ($130). 265/70 R17 comes as a standard tire ($180) and as an LT (light truck) tire ($190). Ask us which one fits your vehicle.

faqs.question: Can I buy one new tire instead of four?
faqs.answer: Sometimes yes. We look at the other tires first. If they are worn out or a very different tread depth, one new tire can make the car unstable, and we will tell you that.

faqs.question: Do you install tires I already bought?
faqs.answer: Yes, but that is a separate service. Bring the tires to 1114 S Military Trl and we mount what you already own. This page is for new tires sold by the shop.

faqs.question: Are you open on Sunday for a new tire?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hours are 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM every day, including Sunday. Call (561) 429-4041 if you want to confirm the size before you come.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment to buy new tires?
faqs.answer: No. Walk-ins are welcome seven days a week, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Call (561) 429-4041 if you want to confirm your size before you come.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cash, credit card, debit card, and NFC (contactless) at the shop.

faqs.question: Do you offer tire financing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Los Paisas Tires Shop offers financing through Snap. The credit decision usually takes about 15 minutes. Ask at the counter at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, or call (561) 429-4041.

faqs.question: How long does a typical tire change take?
faqs.answer: A typical tire swap or install at Los Paisas Tires Shop takes under 45 minutes. Exact time depends on the job and how busy the bay is — call (561) 429-4041 if you want to check before you come.
